notes.title: The "Tutorial Skip" Patch
notes.notes:
Fixed bug that allowed skipping the tutorial due to autosaving feature.
Fixed dialogue bug.

notes.title: The "What Are Quality Settings" Patch
notes.notes:
- Quality settings are now associated with actual performance, and in the correct order.
- Quality settings will no longer reset on opening the game.

KNOWN BUGS
- Very occasionally, some buttons on the guessing menu cannot be clicked. Reopening the journal should fix this.

notes.title: The 'Localisation' Patch
notes.notes:
Turns out, there's a load of sayings that aren't universal. Some of those have been removed from tutorial text.

FEATURES
Whole new tutorial chunk.

BALANCE
Small word changes accepted
Certain verbs added that should've been accepted but weren't

notes.title: The 'Don't Get Trapped In The Security Room' Patch.
notes.notes:
- Fixed getting trapped in the security room, which shouldn't be accessible.
- Also streamlined tutorial section.

notes.title: Resolution Patch
notes.notes:
Tutorial and UI scaling should now be correct for multiple resolutions.

KNOWN ISSUES
Time period lighting is a little whack.

notes.title: Patch 0.45a
notes.notes:
Patch Notes - 0.45a.

BUGS
- Light flickering temporarily fixed. Hooray!
- Some items missing keys and not appearing on clue map. Fixed, and tested for to catch in the future.
- On save/load, items on the clue map could be retriggered, allowing the excellent "A one of a kind speech" become "2 one of a kind speech." Fixed.
- Missing boundaries and colliders in certain time periods, allowing falling through the world. Removed.

"BALANCE"
- Positional clue updates - ensured all clues correctly match the current world state
- A whole shed load of extra options added as accepted verbs and targets for puzzles. 
	- Some colloquialisms that are reasonable were not in the list.
- Socratic Fox Updates - now remembers things you've said.
- Socratic Fox Updates - now provides helpful prompt under certain conditions.
- Ending rework.

KNOWN BUGS
- Resolution scaling on tutorial
- Shadows occasionally pop in and out
